alex-padilla.text: On the ITC downtown mobility-hub contract (Aug 2026): 'Downtown Inglewood is the heart of this City, and this vote is an investment in it... New sidewalks, lighting and mobility hubs will give our small businesses the foot traffic... they deserve.'

source.title: 2UrbanGirls: Inglewood council approves partnership to rebuild historic downtown and improve citywide mobility (Aug 2026)
